platform: Apple M1, 8 physical/logical cores, 8 GiB memory; same machine for every implementation

implementation.change: Extend borrowed semantic-action inventories to read-only validators and descriptor analyses. Ordinary actions are pointer-identical borrows; virtual actions retain their checked owned expansion. Rewriting passes explicitly detach fully owned snapshots before mutation.
implementation.scope: Generic compiler analysis used during compilation and secured linked startup. No k-nucleotide-specific lowering or source change. Emitted computation is unchanged.
implementation.preserved: Same semantic expansion, read traversal, malformed-plan rejection, canonical compiler/catalog, real owners, capability grants, finite cumulative limits, work policy and one host round. No validation bypass, persistent cache, alternate executor, ABI/IR change or resident body fallback.
implementation.feature_fix: Window selection now feature-gates its SequenceLength match. Without pure_text, the absent operation cannot qualify a window region. Full-feature behavior is unchanged.

measurement.method: Twelve serial warm-cache fresh-process rounds per input size. All six orders of three implementations occur twice; each occupies every position four times. One separate correctness/warmup per implementation per size. Identical Node synchronous observer and regular-file capture, descriptors opened before timing. Spawn through exit includes secured report generation; compilation, hashing and parent verification are excluded.
measurement.reports: Every secured report exactly matches the qualified report for that input and its own pinned program revision. Policy, work, comparison, visits, transport, ownership, phases, route and completion are unchanged.

10m.interpretation: 5.7% lower elapsed time than the remeasured previous secured build, faster in all twelve matched rounds. The 0.17 ms (0.19%) median difference from legacy lies within overlapping sample ranges: practical parity, not a demonstrated irreducible security penalty.

125m.interpretation: Approximately tied with legacy. The secured median is 0.53% lower, but overlapping sample ranges do not establish a stable speed advantage.

pins.identity_explanation: Independent standalone documents receive distinct UUID-based nominal owners. ConstantStoreBuilder sorts by SchemaKey, shape and payload; the changed FSM key therefore reordered three constants. The audit proves the exact bijection [2,0,1,3,...,37] from candidate to baseline IDs and exactly two corresponding reference changes. Every remaining section, machine instruction and all three relocations match. Execution still checks each build's own exact artifact/Object/identity pins. Original and decoded candidates are byte-identical.

qualification.focused_tests: Four tests, included in the engine suite, cover original/decoded read and count equivalence, pointer-identical ordinary borrowing, all six checked virtual expansions, malformed metadata/reads and fully owned snapshots surviving plan mutation.
qualification.reduced_feature_result: All four no-default-feature library checks pass without warnings.
qualification.guards: Formatting, diff, warning, production routing, module/native-build layout, runtime boundary audit and fixtures, unsafe, value and memory planner/runtime checks pass.
qualification.release: Original and decoded release applications pass real secured CLI success, denial, cleanup and pin tests. Full125M qualification has eight exact outputs and six timing samples under the same finite launch policy. These separate samples are not mixed into the matched Node comparison.
qualification.supervision: v990 tests, v989 feature checks, v985 release qualification, v987 matched comparison and v991 profile all exit 0 with owned cleanup complete. The 406.2-second release-stage duration includes compilation and qualification; it is not benchmark runtime.
preserved_failures: v983 found an unguarded SequenceLength reference when pure_text was disabled. Fixed the feature guard and reran all four original combinations in v989; no case was removed.
v986 assumed only the standalone nominal key could differ. v994 additionally proves the exact constant-pool permutation and both references, retaining the failed auditor.

v993 exposed lossy JavaScript JSON parsing of a u64 F64 bit encoding in the auditor. v994 preserves original numeric tokens and checks wide-integer roundtrip fixtures. No compiler behavior, artifact or runtime check was changed to satisfy this diagnostic.

profile.kind: Separate launch-time CPU sampling diagnostic, not timing evidence
profile.interpretation: The profile is consistent with less startup copying, but sample weights are not exact causal wall time. Startup analysis remains present; this does not establish an optimization floor.

limitations: Whole-implementation comparison, not isolated permission-check overhead, language ranking or an optimization ceiling. Warm-cache fresh-process results on this M1 and these two inputs do not establish performance for other machines or programs. OS/Rust argv acquisition and stdin provider cache bytes remain outside the managed account, as disclosed in every secured report.
